description: This file is a C++ header defining the StateHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares static methods and static data members related to managing lifecycle states, including state creation, validation, update, and event sending. It references classes like State, ApplicationContext, and interfaces such as ILifecycleManager.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A static class responsible for managing lifecycle state transitions, validations, and events within the framework. It facilitates creating states, validating transitions, updating states, and notifying about state changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the StateHandler system, potentially setting up internal state or resources.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Attempts to change the lifecycle state based on a transition request, setting an error reason if unsuccessful.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new State object for a given application context and lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if transitioning from a start state to a target state is valid according to the defined state transition map.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the current state of the application context to the specified lifecycle state.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event indicating a change from an old lifecycle state to a new one, with an associated error reason if any.

methods.name: getStatePath
methods.description: Retrieves the path of states leading to a specified lifecycle state.
